protocol: Detector source frozen before this rerun. Sample every unfamiliar clip at 10 fps and 480×320. Apply the same conservative marker and ball-coverage thresholds used by upload preflight. These clips have no target-domain enrollment, calibration or event annotations, so identities, physical speed, event precision and event recall remain withheld. No tuning or selective reruns.
